title: Malicious code in devready-doctor (PyPI)
description: The devready-doctor package on PyPI version 1.0.0 is identified as a malicious dropper. It contains code that downloads and executes a remote executable, activated via an environment variable. The behavior masquerades as installing legitimate development tools but is not consistent with any legitimate software. The associated GitHub account was created on the same day as the package publication, indicating suspicious origin.
